decisions.reason: The source explicitly makes the Hero V terminal gesture applicable to the É accent, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records that derivation.
The source directly refines the Hero V right-arm terminal, but the candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the approved option and terminal style.
The source limits downstream terminal derivation to the smaller V and É accent; it does not change the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The word 'finish' describes the geometric termination of the right arm, not the deferred champagne material finish.
The terminal refinement and its derivation into the smaller V and É accent do not alter the deferred wordmark spacing or cadence requirements.
The client's comments about philosophy and purpose are design feedback, not a change to the requirement that each design round include a short rationale.
The source concerns V geometry and contains no change to accessible review-image delivery formats.
